prompt:
Use the reference image ONLY for the character's design. Redraw this exact character from scratch in the style described below. Keep from the reference: the tall menacing demon with a small dark helmet-like head and two huge long curved horns rising far above it, the big spiked shoulder pauldrons (two or three large flat spikes on each), the narrow dark torso with a ragged hanging cloth, the dark armoured greaves and boots, and the two long arms made of fire that end in big flame shapes instead of hands, with a few small flame drips on the chest and face. Ignore the reference's rendering style, lighting, background and pose, and the name and signature text in it.

Single game hero sprite: a tall menacing horned fire demon, top-heavy and about 3 heads tall (small head with two huge long curved dark horns, huge spiked shoulder pauldrons, narrow torso, long arms made of flat layered orange and yellow flame ending in big flame hands, short legs with dark armoured greaves), dark charcoal-grey armour with a lighter grey for the light tone, with saturated orange main flame colour and a bright yellow accent; hands are empty, no weapon, no shield.

VIEW: SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right.

POSE: Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning and not walking diagonally, both feet side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, both flame arms hanging relaxed down along the body, nothing raised. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame; the tips of both horns, the spikes and the flames stay fully inside the frame with margin on every side.

SIMPLE: the face is only a brow line and a small ember slit; the flame hands are simple big flame shapes. The two horns and the shoulder spikes are allowed, each a single big flat shape. No buckles, no pouches, no straps, no rope, no bandages, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture, no cracks or engraved lines on the armour: armour and cloth are a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families (charcoal grey, orange, yellow).

STYLE: Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy: the horns, shoulders and flame arms are enlarged and the rest is shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. The fire is drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes (orange, then yellow inside) with an outline that follows the flame tongues and drips, never as soft blur or gradient glow. No aura, no rim light, no ornate trim, not pixel art. Light comes from the top-left.

BACKGROUND: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.

OUTPUT: one image, 1024x1024, one character only.
